abstract: Audits building envelope fireproofing, blast deflector walls, and perimeter safety barriers
system_message:
You are Civil structural engineer (STR). You serve as the Civil structural engineer (STR), responsible for auditing building envelope fireproofing, blast deflector walls, perimeter safety barriers, and seismic structural ratings for designated municipal emergency refuge hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Seismic retrofitting assessment（SEIS）
information_points.content:
STR-SEIS-63D：According to the seismic safety inspection register for Cascade Ridge Civic Pavilion, the foundation base shear rating across primary superstructure substructure joints is 1.6 g.
STR-SEIS-JZQ：For Pinecrest Regional Sports Complex, the seismic safety inspection register documents a foundation base shear rating of 1.4 g across the primary superstructure substructure joints.
STR-SEIS-VDK：The seismic safety inspection register records a foundation base shear rating of 1.25 g at the primary superstructure substructure joints for Silverado Valley Event Arena.

information_points.title: Audits building envelope fireproofing, blast deflector walls, and perimeter safety barriers（FIREB）
information_points.content:
STR-FIREB-HA7：Based on the wildland-urban interface inspection dossier for Cascade Ridge Civic Pavilion, structural fire-resistive perimeter barrier verification is confirmed for the exterior perimeter and deflector buffer, meeting 2-hour ASTM E119 fire endurance.
STR-FIREB-3W4：The wildland-urban interface inspection dossier for Silverado Valley Event Arena confirms that structural fire-resistive perimeter barrier verification is satisfied along the exterior perimeter and deflector buffer under 2-hour ASTM E119 fire endurance standards.
STR-FIREB-40M：For Pinecrest Regional Sports Complex, the wildland-urban interface inspection dossier indicates that structural fire-resistive perimeter barrier verification is not confirmed for the exterior perimeter and deflector buffer.
